source:
@@U00270@@
clings to the earth with every sensual organ;
the other struggles violently from the dust and
soars to the fields of great departed spirits.
O spirits! if there ave spirits!
You mediating powers between heaven and earth!
Come to me,
come down from your golden mists,
and carry me off to a new and motley life!
Oh, if only I held in my hand
some magic cloak that would sweep me off to
unknown lands, I would never exchange it
for the costliest robes,
no, not for a king’s mantle!

@@U00272@@
No, you mustn't!
Don't summon that swarm,
that throng of demons
that streams through the murky air,
threatening a thousand evils from every quarter!
We've known them far too often!
Sharp-toothed spirits that ride the northern winds
with tongues like arrows;
on withering eastern winds they feed on your lungs;
and if on southern winds
they swarm from the desert with paralyzing waves
of searing heat, from the west
they will come on a wind to revive you with showers,
and drown you then in floods with fields and meadows.
They prick up their ears,
because they're made of mischief;
they gladly obey, the better to betray us;
they pretend to be heaven's angels
while lying with a vengeance.
But it’s time to be going now;
the world’s grown gray.
There’s a chill in the air, mist falling.
It’s only at evening we appreciate our homes.
translation:
@@U00270@@
用每一个感官器官紧贴大地；
另一个在灰尘中剧烈挣扎，
翱翔至伟大亡灵的田野。
诸神啊！如果有灵魂的话！
你们是天地之间的调解者！
到我这里来，
从你金色的薄雾中降临，
带我走向新的、丰富多彩的生活！
哦，如果我握在手里就好了
一些神奇的斗篷可以把我带到
未知的土地，我永远不会交换它
对于最昂贵的长袍，
不，不是为了国王的衣钵！

@@U00272@@
不，你不可以！
不要召唤那群人，
那群恶魔
流过浑浊的空气，
胁迫四方千恶！
我们已经太熟悉他们了！
乘着北风的尖齿精灵
舌头如箭；
在枯萎的东风中，它们以你的肺部为食；
如果刮南风
他们从沙漠中涌出，带着令人瘫痪的波浪
来自西方的灼热热浪
他们会乘风而来，给你带来阵雨，让你苏醒，
然后把你淹没在田野和草地的洪水中。
他们竖起耳朵，
因为它们是由恶作剧组成的；
他们乐意服从，最好背叛我们；
他们假装是天堂的天使
一边复仇地撒谎。
但现在是时候走了；
世界变得灰色。
空气中弥漫着寒意，雾气飘落。
只有到了晚上我们才会欣赏我们的家。
